claim_boundary: The pinned VIA project contributes 105 temporal side/action/outcome rows from 21 annotated epee video references, while a 22nd referenced file has no annotations. The source videos are absent, the annotation protocol and rater agreement are not documented, and overlapping left/right rows describe the same time ranges. The row duration sum is therefore not a unique-video duration; the merged interval union is reported separately. These labels are local research inputs, not externally verified referee decisions or evidence of athlete-independent generalization.
